_finding: The seal block on the landing argues that nobody has to take our word for a record. It would undo its own argument the day it showed "sealed" for a mirror nobody else confirmed, for a hash other than the one the browser computed, or for a case whose day is not mirrored at all. These mutations put each of those back.

mutations.name: a mirror nobody else confirmed is shown as a seal
mutations.find: if (!m || m.status !== 'confirmed' || m.sha256 !== hash || !TX.test(m.tx || '')) return null
mutations.expect: FAIL a mirror that is in a block but not witnessed is not

mutations.name: confirmed with no witness named is enough
mutations.expect: FAIL ...nor one called confirmed with nobody named as witness

mutations.name: the mirror's hash is not compared with the one computed here
mutations.expect: FAIL a mirror of other bytes is not a seal of these

mutations.name: a case of a day with no mirror is offered
mutations.expect: FAIL a case of a day that is not mirrored yet is not offered

mutations.name: the creator's text is passed on whole
mutations.expect: FAIL the creator's text is cut to a label

mutations.name: a day with no Bitcoin check on file is said to have one
mutations.expect: FAIL a case says whether its day has a Bitcoin check on file

mutations.name: the line shown drifts from the one the transaction carries
mutations.expect: FAIL the line shown is, letter for letter, the one the Base transaction carries

mutations.name: the oldest sealed day comes first
mutations.expect: FAIL the newest sealed day comes first, whatever the date, so the block shows last night's seal

mutations.name: the whole week rotates again, so any day can be on top
mutations.find: const out = [...byDay.keys()].sort().reverse().flatMap((d) => { const g = byDay.get(d), i = k % g.length; return g.slice(i).concat(g.slice(0, i)) })
mutations.replace: const i0 = k % (real.length || 1), out = real.slice(i0).concat(real.slice(0, i0))
mutations.expect: FAIL the newest sealed day comes first, whatever the date, so the block shows last night's seal
